score_rationale.bottleneck_strength: DOE documented lead times at and beyond 36 months, custom qualification, limited build slots, and slow factory/tooling expansion before the trigger.
score_rationale.economic_capture: Supplier capacity additions corroborate demand, but the frozen evidence does not establish durable pricing power or margin capture at the economic node.
score_rationale.reinvestment_runway: DOE projected U.S. LPT demand to more than double by 2030 while new factory and specialized-equipment lead times remained measured in years.
score_rationale.triangulation: The frozen path and state combine U.S. government physical data, grid-regulatory records, issuer backlog, customer architecture, and two independent supplier expansions.
score_rationale.expectation_gap: The frozen market trigger is for fabricated structural metal and contains no direct transformer valuation or priced-in-expectation measure, so expectation gap remains unproven.
